documents.title: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Rajputana Biodiesel Limited operates two biodiesel manufacturing facilities in Phulera and Meerut with an aggregate capacity of 170 KLPD. The company has secured supply contracts with major Oil Marketing Companies (HPCL, BPCL, and IOCL) and is expanding into Compressed BioGas (CBG) and Biomass Pellets. Additionally, the company has achieved VERRA Carbon Credit Certification and incorporated Rajputana Agro LLP to secure its feedstock supply chain. Rajputana Biodiesel Limited reported strong performance in H1 FY26 and expects heavier numbers in H2. The company has successfully enhanced capacity at its Phulera and Meerut units by 3-4 times and aims to produce 130 to 150 kilolitres per day in the coming financial year.

guidance.claim: The company expects its H2 numbers to be heavier than its H1 numbers.
guidance.quote: Our H2 numbers will be heavier than H1 numbers.

guidance.claim: The company aims to produce 130 to 150 kilolitres per day from the coming financial year.
guidance.quote: From April onwards, from coming April onwards, our bids in the OMC tender would be as per our enhanced capacity and we are aiming to produce 130 to 150 kilolitres per day from the coming financial year.

guidance.claim: The company is on track to achieve its goal of becoming a one-stop solution for renewable energy across solid, liquid, and gas segments.
guidance.quote: We are absolutely on track to fulfil our vision and mission in becoming a one-stop solution for renewable energy in the Solid, Liquid and Gas segments.

demand_outlook.claim: There are structural supply gaps of over 5,200 ML of biodiesel and a 14.5 MMT CBG deficit by 2030.
demand_outlook.quote: Structural supply gaps: >5,200 ML biodiesel & 14.5 MMT CBG deficit by 2030

demand_outlook.claim: The National Biofuels Policy of 2018 has an indicative target of blending 5% biodiesel into diesel.
demand_outlook.quote: As per National Biofuels Policy of 2018, there is an indicative target of blending 5% biodiesel into diesel.

demand_outlook.claim: The biodiesel sector has the potential of an industry of around INR 45,000 crores to INR 50,000 crores.
demand_outlook.quote: It has the potential of an industry of around INR 45,000 crores to INR 50,000 crores.

demand_outlook.claim: There is a mandate issued by the Government of India to blend 5% biomass pellets with coal in thermal power plants.
demand_outlook.quote: This is also a mandate issued by the Government of India where they have to blend 5% biomass pellets with coal in the thermal power plants.

demand_outlook.claim: A mandate starting January 1, 2028, will make it compulsory to blend 24% biodiesel into marine fuel.
demand_outlook.quote: There is also a mandate coming from 1st January 2028 where it becomes compulsory to blend 24% biodiesel into marine fuel.

demand_outlook.claim: The company has recently received large-scale orders from government PSUs.
demand_outlook.quote: The recent large-scale orders from government PSUs, investments in capacity expansion, technological upgrades at biodiesel plants, along with our entry into the CBG and Pellets segment, collectively reaffirm our strategic roadmap toward becoming a comprehensive and integrated BioEnergy company.

capex_expansion.claim: The company incorporated Rajputana Agro LLP to source and supply raw materials for CBG, biofuels, and other renewable energy products.
capex_expansion.quote: Primary Purpose: To source and supply raw materials (biomass feedstock) required for the production of Compressed BioGas (CBG), biofuels and other renewable energy products

capex_expansion.claim: The company has successfully enhanced capacity at its Phulera and Meerut units by almost 3-4 times.
capex_expansion.quote: We have successfully enhanced capacity at our Phulera and Meerut units by almost 3-4 times.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has received approvals for establishing two compressed biogas units in Rajasthan.
capex_expansion.quote: As mentioned in our annual report also, for those who have missed the annual report or not gone through it, we have received approvals for establishing two compressed biogas units in the state of Rajasthan.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is looking to start the civil work of its compressed biogas project by January end.
capex_expansion.quote: By January end, we are looking to start the civil work of this compressed biogas project.

capex_expansion.claim: The company intends to start civil work for a unit tapping the European Union and GCC marine blending market.
capex_expansion.quote: Last but not the least, we intend to start the civil work of our unit that will be tapping the European Union and the marine blending market of biodiesel in the GCC.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is starting with a 10 tons per day CBG unit in the Ajmer region of Rajasthan.
capex_expansion.quote: And CBG unit is 10 tons per day that we are starting with in the Ajmer region in Rajasthan.

capex_expansion.claim: The company acquired Nirvaanraj Energy Private Limited, which has an 80 KLPD capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: Acquisition of Nirvaanraj Energy Private Limited (80 KLPD capacity)

margins_costs.claim: Rajputana Agro LLP provides a captive, integrated feedstock supply chain to reduce input cost volatility and secure raw material availability.
margins_costs.quote: Strategic Role: Provides a captive, integrated feedstock supply chain — reducing input cost volatility and securing raw material availability for CBG plants at Ajmer and Nagaur.

margins_costs.claim: The company expects EBITDA margins to be more than 55% to 60% in the CBG sector.
margins_costs.quote: But trust me, the EBITDA margins are more than 55%-60% in the CBG sector.

margins_costs.claim: The company expects a 70% to 75% EBITDA margin in the CBG segment.
margins_costs.quote: It’s very easy to quote all these numbers, 30% EBITDA and 40% PAT. I don’t know on what basis the competitor has said that, but surely 70%-75% EBITDA is there.

margins_costs.claim: The company's cost of feedstock for CBG is almost half of what is available in the market.
margins_costs.quote: Our cost of feedstock is almost half of what is available in the market, at the same gas percent yield.

orders_capacity.claim: The company expects to complete its previous biodiesel allocations of approximately INR 100 crores by the end of November.
orders_capacity.quote: By November end of this year, we would be completing our previous biodiesel allocations of approximately INR100 crores.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has bid the highest volume of biodiesel supply ever in its history for the current OMC tender.
orders_capacity.quote: I am very delighted to share that the current OMC's biodiesel tender for the period of November to March 2026 is out and really glad to share with you that we have bid the highest volume of biodiesel supply ever in our history.

orders_capacity.claim: The company expects to commission its enhanced capacities by December end or early January.
orders_capacity.quote: I believe that by December end and January starting, we will be able to commission our enhanced capacities.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has secured long-term supply contracts with OMCs including HPCL, BPCL, and IOCL.
orders_capacity.quote: Long-term supply contracts with OMC's (HPCL, BPCL and IOCL)

capital_allocation.claim: The company's long-term borrowings stood at 417.45 Lakhs in FY26 compared to 554.45 Lakhs in FY25.
The company's cash and cash equivalents increased to 205.82 Lakhs in FY26 from 156.15 Lakhs in FY25.
The company successfully utilized capital raised in its IPO for working capital, technical upgradation, and capacity enhancement.
capital_allocation.quote: We successfully utilized the capital raised in our IPO for immediate working capital needs and technical upgradation along with capacity enhancement.

capital_allocation.claim: The company plans to raise money for the GCC and CBG units through a preferential round.
capital_allocation.quote: We are planning to go for a preferential round in the times to come for raising money for the GCC unit and the CBG unit.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's strategic roadmap includes the deleveraging of its balance sheet.

risks_headwinds.claim: Pricing sometimes becomes a point of discussion in the review of the National Biofuels Policy.
risks_headwinds.quote: The only thing is that sometimes in the review of policy, pricing becomes a point of discussion.

risks_headwinds.claim: Freight costs from India to Europe are exorbitant and ships are difficult to find at Mundra and Kandla.
risks_headwinds.quote: Because freight costs from India to Europe are exorbitant. There is not enough traffic at Mundra and Kandla, you don't find ships.
